name: Runemaster audit: Wind Runes extends Hurricane's duration by 1s, adding 2 more native strikes (#3089)
contract: Wind Runes 706672 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), EffectBasePoints 999 + DieSides 1 = +1000ms, EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 256, matching Hurricane 645435's SpellFamilyFlags word 0 bit 8 (256) exactly.

Hurricane's own aura is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DUMMY (EffectApplyAuraName 226) at EffectAmplitude 500ms, base SpellDuration 39 = 2000ms; AscensionRunemasterHurricane.cpp's aura_ascension_runemaster_hurricane::Tick calls StrikeHurricane on every native OnEffectPeriodic tick with no hardcoded strike counter, so duration alone controls tick count.

2000ms / 500ms = 4 native periodic ticks without Wind Runes; (2000+1000)ms / 500ms = 6 native periodic ticks with it - 2 more, matching the tooltip exactly. Player::ApplySpellMod applies the duration mod at cast time through the same native path proven for Battle Engravings (#3090).

steps.label: SETUP: without Wind Runes, Hurricane strikes at least 4 times (4 native ticks)
CONTRACT: with Wind Runes, this Hurricane cast alone strikes at least 6 times (6 native ticks, 2 more than without it)
